note: Synthetic fixtures of known answer for the readability tool v1.1.0 (copy of the v1.0.0 spec; the four old fixtures that concerned the tips page - F01, F04, F06, F07, F09 - were rewritten for the new tip rule, F06 and F07 keep their meaning; all others are unchanged; T01 to T16 are new). Every text is invented (gardens, kitchens, boats); none is from the exam. Each broken fixture is broken in the one way its expect field names. A case with solo=true is built into its own paper and items file (so a tips page does not touch the other cases).

cases.label: 1a
cases.stem: A baker has six trays and bakes one loaf on each tray first. Which statement about the loaves is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A tray is a flat board for baking.

cases.label: 1b
cases.stem: A gardener plants twelve rows of beans along the north fence. She waters every row each morning and counts the plants after three weeks. A neighbour borrows four rows for a school fair and returns the same number of plants in spring. The gardener keeps one card for each place on the farm. Which statement about the cards is correct?

cases.label: 1c
cases.stem: A gardener plants twelve rows of beans along the north fence. She waters every row each morning and counts the plants after three weeks. A neighbour borrows four rows for a school fair and returns the same number of plants in spring. The gardener keeps one card for each place on the farm. Which single statement about the cards is correct?

cases.label: 1d
cases.stem: A lamp hangs over a table and is switched on at dusk. Tips: lamp: a light that hangs from a hook. Which statement about the lamp is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A lamp is a light.

cases.label: 1e
cases.stem: A traveller buys a ticket for the evening tram. Ticket: a paper that lets a person ride. Which statement about the traveller is correct?

cases.label: 1f
cases.stem: A cook stirs a pot of soup for ten minutes and then adds salt. Which statement about the soup is correct?

cases.label: 1g
cases.stem: A child counts the steps from the door to the gate. Which statement about the steps is correct (see tip 9z)?
tip_lines: Tip: A step is one pace.

cases.label: 1h
cases.stem: Chance, in percent, that a train is late when it rains: for light rain 4, for heavy rain 12. Which statement about the trains is correct?

cases.label: 1i
cases.stem: Two painters share one ladder and take turns at the top. Which statement about the ladder is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A ladder is a frame with steps.

cases.label: 1j
cases.stem: The RTU sends a number to the office every hour. Which statement about the number is correct?

cases.label: 1k
cases.stem: A boat carries a global positioning system (GPS) receiver on its mast. Which statement about the receiver is correct?

cases.label: 1l
cases.stem: The GPS receiver shows the same place twice in a row. Which statement about the place is correct?

cases.label: 1m
cases.stem: The LED (light-emitting diode) on the box turns red at noon. Which statement about the box is correct?

cases.label: 1n
cases.stem: Circle the answer that is NOT true about the FIRST train of the day, which leaves before the second one.

cases.label: 2a
cases.stem: A kettle needs 4 minutes to boil one litre of water. Three litres are boiled one after the other. How long is the whole boiling?
cases.format_line: Sheet row 2a, one digit per box. Unit: minutes.

cases.label: 2b
cases.stem: A shelf holds 24 books and 3 shelves are full. How many books are on the shelves?
cases.format_line: Write the whole number of books on the shelves in the boxes of row 2b, one figure in each box, and keep each inside it. Thank you very much indeed.

cases.label: 2c
cases.stem: A taxi drives 12 kilometres in 15 minutes. How long does it need for 36 kilometres?
cases.format_line: The number goes in the boxes of row 2c, in minutes.

cases.label: 2d
cases.stem: A tank holds 90 litres and a pump moves 6 litres a minute. How long does the pump need to empty it?
cases.format_line: Write the whole number of minutes in the boxes of row 2d.

cases.label: 2e
cases.stem: A rope is cut into 5 pieces of 3 metres each. How long was the rope?
cases.format_line: Write the whole number in the boxes of row 2e.

cases.label: 2f
cases.stem: A cake loses 40 grams of water in the oven and weighs 360 grams afterwards. How much did it weigh before baking?
cases.format_line: Fill the boxes of row 2f with the whole number of grams that the cake weighs, one figure in each box, from the right side.

cases.label: 2g
cases.stem: A jar holds 250 grams of rice and 6 jars are filled. How much rice is in the jars?
cases.format_line: Write the number of grams in Sheet row 2g (the row of boxes marked 2g on your answer sheet).

cases.label: 2h
cases.stem: A bag holds 500 grams of flour and 4 bags are opened. How much flour is open?
cases.format_line: Write the number of grams, one digit per box.

cases.label: 3a
cases.stem: A skipper ties four ropes to a dock post before the storm. Which statement about the ropes is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A dock is a landing place for boats.

cases.label: 3b
cases.stem: A sailor reads the depth of a harbour at dawn and again at dusk. Which statement about the two readings is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A row is a line of plants that the gardener waters daily.

cases.label: 3c
cases.stem: A ferry crosses a bay twice before noon with a full deck. Which statement about the crossings is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A row is a line of plants that the gardener waters daily early.

cases.label: 3d
cases.stem: A pilot guides a long ship through a narrow canal at night. Which statement about the canal is correct?

cases.label: 3e
cases.stem: A fisher mends a net on the quay while the tide goes out. Which statement about the net is correct?

tips_page.3e: A quay is a stone landing.

cases.label: 3f
cases.stem: A diver counts the anchors on the sea floor beside a wreck. Which statement about the anchors is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: An anchor holds a boat in place.
Tip: A wreck is a ship that sank.

cases.label: 3g
cases.stem: A lighthouse keeper polishes the big lens every week. Tip: A lens is a curved glass. Which statement about the lens is correct?

cases.label: 3h
cases.stem: A harbour master checks the flags on five boats at sunrise. Which statement about the flags is correct (see tip 3h)?
tip_lines: Tip: A flag is a cloth on a pole.

cases.label: 3i
cases.stem: A cook weighs three sacks of flour at the start of the day. Which statement about the sacks is correct?

cases.label: 3j
cases.stem: A miller turns the great wheel once for each sack of grain. Which statement about the wheel is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A mill grinds grain into flour.

cases.label: 3k
cases.stem: A boy rows a small boat across the lake in the morning. Which statement about the lake is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A lake is a large body of still water.

cases.label: 3l
cases.stem: A guard locks the east gate of the harbour every evening. Which statement about the gate is correct?

cases.label: 3m
cases.stem: A potter fires six bowls in the big kiln on Monday. Which statement about the bowls is correct?
tip_lines: Tips: A kiln is an oven for clay.

cases.label: 3n
cases.stem: A baker needs 3 minutes to fill one tray. How long do 8 trays need?
cases.format_line: Write the whole number of minutes in the boxes of row 3n.
tip_lines: Tip: Seven rows - one for each day - hold 3 beans and 4 peas.

cases.label: 3o
cases.stem: A rower pulls twelve strokes each minute for five minutes. Which statement about the strokes is correct?
tip_lines: Tip: A stroke is one full pull of the oar.

cases.label: 3p
cases.stem: A sailmaker sews four sails for the new boat this month. Which statement about the sails is correct (see tip 3p)?

tips_page.3p: A sail is a cloth that catches wind.
